page.layout: One title page, centred. Upper block: title lines in roman, italic and spaced capitals. Below: a short italic paragraph. Lower block: two parallel columns of Hebrew entries, the left column first, then the right column, separated by a vertical rule. No running head, page number or catchword.

page.notes: Stains and show-through obscure parts of the title, notably "aliisque", "locupletatus", "Schrivetiani", "repræsen-" and "EDITUS". The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh in the table are small and partly blurred, so the Hebrew forms are doubtful and marked [?]. The "A" near the centre under the title and the "A" at the foot of the right column may be signatures or stains; I could not decide, so I kept the latter in its line. "AD" and "A D" under HEBRÆO-BIBLICI are read as one word "AD".
